auto_shoutout.added: %{login} now gets a shoutout on their first chat message in the stream.
auto_shoutout.error.bad_login: That is not a valid Twitch login. Allowed are lower-case letters, digits and underscore, up to 25 characters.
auto_shoutout.error.cooldown: Twitch cooldown (two minutes between shoutouts, sixty for the same channel) – will be retried.
auto_shoutout.error.forbidden: Twitch denies the shoutout. The “shoutouts” permission is probably missing.
auto_shoutout.error.no_such_channel: Twitch does not know the channel “%{login}”.
auto_shoutout.error.no_target_id: The Twitch id of the channel is unknown.
auto_shoutout.error.unauthorized: Twitch rejected the sign-in. The channel has to be reconnected.
auto_shoutout.is_off: Auto shoutout is switched off – no shoutout is triggered.
auto_shoutout.lead: When a listed channel writes in chat for the first time during the current stream, it automatically gets a Twitch shoutout.
auto_shoutout.name: Auto shoutout
auto_shoutout.no_channels: No channel yet. Add one – as soon as it writes in chat, it gets the shoutout.
auto_shoutout.no_scope_hint: Without the “shoutouts” permission Twitch will not accept a shoutout. The channel has to be reconnected once.
auto_shoutout.perm.toggle: may switch auto shoutout on and off.
auto_shoutout.round_hint: Each channel gets at most one shoutout per round. A new round starts by itself when your stream goes live.
auto_shoutout.round_reset: New round – every channel gets a shoutout again on its next message.
auto_shoutout.toggle_hint: Switch auto shoutout on or off
